characters.name: John Douglas
characters.description: Owner of Birlstone Manor House, about fifty years old, with a rugged face, grizzled moustache, keen gray eyes, and a wiry figure. He formerly lived in America before settling in England.

characters.name: Mrs. Douglas
characters.description: Wife of John Douglas; a beautiful, tall, dark, and slender English lady about twenty years younger than her husband.

characters.name: Cecil James Barker
characters.description: Wealthy bachelor residing at Hales Lodge, Hampstead, and an intimate friend of John Douglas from America; tall, broad-chested, clean-shaved with thick black eyebrows.

characters.name: Sergeant Wilson
characters.description: Police officer of the Sussex Constabulary in charge of the local Birlstone police station who first investigates the murder at Manor House.

characters.name: Dr. Wood
characters.description: Brisk and capable general practitioner from Birlstone village who examines John Douglas's body at the scene.

characters.name: Ames
characters.description: The prim, respectable, and capable butler at Birlstone Manor House.

characters.name: Mrs. Allen
characters.description: The buxom and cheerful housekeeper at Birlstone Manor House who relieves Mrs. Douglas of household duties.

characters.name: White Mason
characters.description: Chief Sussex detective, a quiet, comfortable-looking man in a loose tweed suit with bandy legs and a ruddy face, investigating the Birlstone tragedy.

characters.name: Sherlock Holmes
characters.description: Consulting detective investigating the circumstances surrounding the murder at Birlstone.

characters.name: Dr. Watson
characters.description: Companion and associate of Sherlock Holmes.

characters.name: MacDonald
characters.description: Detective attending the case briefing alongside Sherlock Holmes.

locations.name: Birlstone Manor House
locations.description: An ancient moated house in Sussex, converted into an island at night by raising its drawbridge, and scene of John Douglas's murder.

locations.name: Birlstone
locations.description: A quiet countryside village in Sussex containing the Manor House, local police station, and Westville Arms inn.

locations.name: Hales Lodge, Hampstead
locations.description: The residence of Cecil James Barker.

locations.name: Westville Arms
locations.description: An inn in Birlstone where Sherlock Holmes, Dr. Watson, and MacDonald reside during the investigation.

relationships.subject: John Douglas
relationships.explanation: John Douglas met Mrs. Douglas in London when he was a widower, and they married.

relationships.subject: Cecil James Barker
relationships.explanation: Cecil Barker first knew John Douglas in America, lived on intimate terms with him, and remained his close friend in England.

relationships.subject: Cecil James Barker
relationships.explanation: Barker was friendly with Mrs. Douglas, driving around the countryside with her during her husband's absence.

relationships.subject: Ames
relationships.explanation: Ames serves as the butler for John Douglas at Birlstone Manor House.

relationships.subject: Mrs. Allen
relationships.explanation: Mrs. Allen acts as housekeeper and assists Mrs. Douglas with domestic cares.

relationships.subject: White Mason
relationships.explanation: Sergeant Wilson calls White Mason, chief Sussex detective, to lead the local murder investigation.

relationships.subject: Sherlock Holmes
relationships.explanation: Dr. Watson accompanies Sherlock Holmes to Birlstone for the murder investigation.
